name: Criminally Yours
source:
You're the next generation of heroes—"Oracle," given to your mother and you for your ability to see glimpses into the future.

The only thing that stands in your way of keeping peace in the city is the supervillain "Chronos".

When you aren't protecting the city from Chronos, you're just an average everyday civilian working as a project manager with your long-time crush, Nikolaos.

Little do you know that Nikolaos knows your secret, but you don't know his—that he and Chronos are one and the same.

[From [url=https://meant-to-bee-studios.itch.io/criminally-yours]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是下一代英雄——“甲骨文”，被授予你的母亲和你，因为你有能力看到未来。

唯一阻碍你维护城市和平的是超级恶棍“克罗诺斯”。

当你不保护城市免受克罗诺斯侵害时，你只是一个普通的平民，与你暗恋已久的尼古拉斯一起担任项目经理。

你几乎不知道尼古拉斯知道你的秘密，但你不知道他的秘密——他和克罗诺斯是同一个人。

[来自[url=https://meant-to-bee-studios.itch.io/criminally-yours]itch.io[/url]]
